import { motion, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import { useId, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

export interface FeatureCallout {
  /** Short name of the feature. */
  title: string
  /** One or two sentences. */
  description: ReactNode
  /** Decorative icon. */
  icon?: ReactNode
}

export interface FeaturesShowcaseProps {
  /** Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Copy under the headline. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Product image or mock-up in the middle. */
  media: ReactNode
  /** Callouts on the left of the media. Right-aligned on wide containers. */
  left: FeatureCallout[]
  /** Callouts on the right of the media. */
  right: FeatureCallout[]
  /** Element for the headline. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  /** Element for the root. */
  as?: ElementType
  /** Seconds each callout takes to fade in. */
  duration?: number
  /** Turns the entrance animation off. */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

/** A product shot in the middle with feature callouts on both sides; they stack under it on narrow containers. */
export function FeaturesShowcase({
  title,
  description,
  media,
  left,
  right,
  titleAs: Title = 'h2',
  as: Tag = 'section',
  duration = 0.5,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: FeaturesShowcaseProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const animate = !disabled && !reduced

  const column = (items: FeatureCallout[], side: 'left' | 'right') => (
    <ul className={cn('flex flex-col justify-around gap-8', side === 'left' && '@4xl:items-end @4xl:text-right')}>
      {items.map((f, i) => (
        <motion.li
          key={f.title}
          initial={animate ? { opacity: 0, x: side === 'left' ? -20 : 20 } : false}
          whileInView={animate ? { opacity: 1, x: 0 } : undefined}
          viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-40px' }}
          transition={{ duration, delay: i * 0.08, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          className={cn('flex max-w-xs flex-col gap-2', side === 'left' && '@4xl:items-end')}
        >
          {f.icon != null && (
            <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary [&_svg]:size-4.5">
              {f.icon}
            </span>
          )}
          <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{f.title}</h3>
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{f.description}</p>
        </motion.li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )

  return (
    <Tag aria-labelledby={id} className={cn('@container w-full', className)}>
      <div className="mx-auto mb-12 flex max-w-2xl flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <Title id={id} className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground @xl:text-4xl">
          {title}
        </Title>
        {description != null && <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="grid items-center gap-10 @4xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] @4xl:gap-8">
        <div className="min-w-0 @4xl:order-2">{media}</div>
        <div className="@4xl:order-1">{column(left, 'left')}</div>
        <div className="@4xl:order-3">{column(right, 'right')}</div>
      </div>
    </Tag>
  )
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { FeaturesShowcase } from '@/components/features-showcase'

const Icon = ({ d }: { d: string }): ReactNode => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d={d} />
  </svg>
)

function Phone() {
  return (
    <div aria-hidden className="mx-auto w-48 rounded-[2rem] border-4 border-foreground/80 bg-card p-3 shadow-xl shadow-foreground/10">
      <div className="mx-auto mb-3 h-1.5 w-12 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30" />
      <div className="space-y-2.5">
        <span className="block h-20 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-br from-primary/60 to-primary/20" />
        {[80, 60, 70].map((w, i) => (
          <span key={i} style={{ width: `${w}%` }} className="block h-2.5 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/20" />
        ))}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
          <span className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted" />
          <span className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted" />
        </div>
        <span className="block h-9 rounded-full bg-primary" />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function FeaturesShowcaseDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl">
      <FeaturesShowcase
        title="Made for the device in your hand"
        description="Six details that make the mobile app feel native."
        media={<Phone />}
        left={[
          { title: 'Instant start', description: 'Opens in under a second, even on slow networks.', icon: <Icon d="m3.75 13.5 10.5-11.25L12 10.5h8.25L9.75 21.75 12 13.5H3.75z" /> },
          { title: 'Works offline', description: 'Read and edit without a signal; changes sync later.', icon: <Icon d="M2 8.8a15 15 0 0 1 20 0M5 12.5a10 10 0 0 1 14 0M8.5 16a5 5 0 0 1 7 0M12 20h.01" /> },
          { title: 'Gestures', description: 'Swipe to archive, hold to reorder.', icon: <Icon d="M9 11V5a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v6m0 0 4 1v5a4 4 0 0 1-4 4h-2a4 4 0 0 1-3-1.3L5 15l2-1 2 2" /> },
        ]}
        right={[
          { title: 'Biometric lock', description: 'Face or fingerprint protects every workspace.', icon: <Icon d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z" /> },
          { title: 'Widgets', description: 'Glance at what matters from your home screen.', icon: <Icon d="M4 4h7v7H4zM13 4h7v7h-7zM4 13h7v7H4zM13 13h7v7h-7z" /> },
          { title: 'Dark mode', description: 'Follows the system theme at any hour.', icon: <Icon d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.8z" /> },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
